integrity: The proof uses only the independence of positive support and the defining double Roman neighborhood conditions. A separate exhaustive checker tests the definition directly on all complete multipartite isomorphism types through order nine.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
The minimum-value corollary is partly implied by published general inequalities; the new content is the all-function classification and weight enumerator.
Finite exhaustive verification through order nine is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed enumerative work.
title: Independent double Roman functions on complete multipartite graphs
